extension.description: Common library used by Anchor: Trakt and Simkl scrobbling (watch history and cross-device resume points), the shared scrobble gate, and IntroDB intro/recap timestamps for skip-intro. It ships no media, catalogs or stream sources.
extension.news: v0.1.22 - Trakt/Simkl app credentials are now bring-your-own: the library embeds none and the using add-on binds them live from its settings via set_credentials(). configured() reflects whether the user has entered them. v0.1.21 - Trakt and Simkl scrobbling clients with a shared scrobble gate, cross-device resume, and IntroDB intro/recap lookups. Trakt OAuth (authorize, device code, token refresh) uses auth.trakt.tv; a built-in Trakt app means no per-user setup. Robustness: a revoked Trakt token clears and flags re-authorization; the shared HTTP helper never raises on a truncated or non-UTF-8 response (IntroDB lookups made equally defensive). Works on boxes without script.module.requests (urllib fallback with an explicit User-Agent) and on Apple TV (tvOS).
extension.disclaimer: Anchor is an independent project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with the Kodi/XBMC Foundation, Trakt, Simkl or IntroDB. It ships no media, content or stream sources. Do not use it for piracy or to access content you are not authorised to.
